request.label: Send request
request.description: Send a saved request, try it again until it passes, or take another path when it fails.

set.label: Set variables
set.description: Keep values from a response or a template for the next steps.

if.label: If
if.description: Check a response or variables and branch.

forEach.label: For each
forEach.description: Repeat steps for every item of a list in a response.

end.label: End
end.description: Stop the flow as passed or failed.

flowEngine.noSteps: The flow has no steps. Add one to run it.
flowEngine.unknownKind: "{{kind}}" is not a kind of step. Use request, set, if, forEach, delay or end.
flowEngine.noRequest: Choose the saved request this step sends.
flowEngine.missingRequest: No saved request matches "{{reference}}". Choose it again.
flowEngine.unknownTarget: {{field}} "{{target}}", which is not a step of this flow.
flowEngine.intoLoop: {{field}} "{{target}}", a step inside a For each that this step is not part of. Go to the For each step instead.
flowEngine.noName: Every value needs a variable name.
flowEngine.noValueStep: Choose the Send request step that "{{name}}" comes from.
flowEngine.noSource: Give the JSONPath of "{{name}}" in the response, for example $.token.
flowEngine.notRequestStep: "{{target}}" is not a Send request step of this flow.
flowEngine.noList: Choose the Send request step whose response holds the list.
flowEngine.noPath: Give the JSONPath of the list, for example $.items.
flowEngine.emptyLoop: Add the steps to repeat inside For each.
flowEngine.cannotRun_one: The flow cannot run until {{count}} problem is fixed.
flowEngine.cannotRun_other: The flow cannot run until {{count}} problems are fixed.
flowEngine.notRunYet: {{title}} has not sent its request yet, so its response cannot be used.
flowEngine.nothingFound: Nothing was found at {{path}} in the response of {{title}}.
flowEngine.noHeader: The response of {{title}} has no {{name}} header.
flowEngine.notAList: {{path}} in the response of {{title}} is not a list.
flowEngine.budget_one: The flow sent {{count}} request, its limit, and was stopped. Give loops a way to end, or raise the limit in the flow settings (at most {{cap}}).
flowEngine.budget_other: The flow sent {{count}} requests, its limit, and was stopped. Give loops a way to end, or raise the limit in the flow settings (at most {{cap}}).
flowEngine.endless_one: The flow went through {{count}} step without sending a request and was stopped. Check where its steps go next.
flowEngine.endless_other: The flow went through {{count}} steps without sending a request and was stopped. Check where its steps go next.
flowEngine.timedOut: Choosing the next step took longer than {{seconds}} s, so the flow was stopped.
flowEngine.failedAt: {{title}} failed and has no step to go to when it fails.
flowEngine.ended: An End step stopped the flow.
flowEngine.endedFailed: An End step stopped the flow as failed.
flowEngine.attemptFailedOf: Failed on the last attempt ({{attempt}} of {{attempts}}).
flowEngine.emptyList: The list is empty, so its steps were skipped.

flowImport.missingRequests: Steps of the flow "{{name}}" send requests that are not in the import; choose them again before running it.

flowTemplate.description: Log in, wait until the order is ready and cancel it when it never gets there. Choose the request of each Send request step to make it yours.
flowTemplate.waitForOrder: Wait until the order is ready
flowTemplate.cancelledMessage: The order never got ready, so it was cancelled.

flow.emptyDescription: A flow sends saved requests one after another, tries them again until they pass, takes another path when one fails and passes values along. Run it here or with gostman flow run.
flow.deleteMessage: Delete the flow "{{name}}"? This can't be undone.
flow.closeMessage: "{{name}}" has unsaved changes. Save them before closing?
flow.noCurl: A flow has no curl command. Open one of its requests to copy it.

flowCanvas.removeMessage: Delete the step "{{title}}"? Steps that went to it continue with the next step instead.

flowPicker.title: Choose a request
flowPicker.noRequestsHint: Save a request first; a flow sends saved requests.

flowEditor.label: Label
flowEditor.variablesHint: Set only while this step sends, above every other scope. Values can use {{variables}}, such as {{example}} inside For each.
flowEditor.untilHint: The step passes when a response arrives, its own checks pass and these checks pass. Otherwise it tries again, up to the number of attempts.
flowEditor.afterLoop: After the last item, go to
flowEditor.responseConditionHint: Write expressions as res.status, res.body.field or res.headers.name.
flowEditor.variablesConditionHint: Write the variable name in the first column, for example token.
flowEditor.loopHint: Inside, {{item}} is the item, {{field}} one of its fields and {{index}} its position from 0.
flowEditor.valuesHint: Values live in the session for the rest of the run, like Extract rules, and are never saved.

flowView.descriptionPlaceholder: What this flow checks, for the next person who opens it
flowView.maxSendsHint: A run stops after this many requests, so a loop without an end cannot run forever (at most {{cap}}).
flowView.selectHint: Select a step to edit it, or use + to add one. Steps run from top to bottom; branches are drawn on the right.
flowView.problems_one: {{count}} thing needs attention before the flow can run
flowView.problems_other: {{count}} things need attention before the flow can run
flowView.cliHint: Run it from a terminal or CI in the workspace folder:

flowRun.idleHint: Run sends the steps with the active environment and shows each one here as it happens.

flowScript.stopped: Not sent because a script stopped the run.
